verdict.rationale: Ramp documents automatic receipt capture at swipe time, with memos and categories filled in, and receipts tied to the transaction without filing an expense report (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-32, ramp-docs-45). It also sends automated reminders for missing items (ramp-docs-13), and its CLI and MCP surface missing-receipt detection through transactions missing/flag-missing/explain-missing and receipt attach (ramp-supp-cli-agent-mode, ramp-docs-29). missing for 10: explicit evidence of e-receipts pulled from third-party integrations (e.g., merchant or email sources), documentation that nudges fire only when no receipt can be auto-matched, and independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
